persona: College/university students studying from PDFs, textbooks, and lecture slides
title: summarize my textbook chapter and let me ask questions about it
workflowSummary: Upload your lecture slides, textbook PDF, or class readings as "sources." NotebookLM reads only that material and answers your questions with inline citations pointing back to the exact page or section, and can auto-generate a study guide, FAQ, or timeline.
samplePrompt: Using only the sources I uploaded, create a study guide with the 10 most important concepts, then quiz me on them one at a time.
beginnerNote: no cost to start, drag-and-drop upload, plain-language interface
pricingNote: Free tier available with a Google account; higher limits/extra features via Google One AI Premium - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public product page; free Google account required to use the tool; no login needed to view the marketing page

persona: High school/college students preparing for a test
title: turn my class notes into flashcards to study for a test
workflowSummary: Paste typed notes, upload a photo/PDF of handwritten notes, or type a topic, and Quizlet's AI builds a full flashcard set automatically. The same material can also become a study guide or practice test.
samplePrompt: Turn these lecture notes into a 20-card flashcard set, with the term on the front and a short plain-English definition on the back.
beginnerNote: simple upload/paste flow, most students already know the app
pricingNote: Free to start; full AI study tools require a Quizlet Plus subscription - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public feature page, no login required to view

persona: High school/college students in exam-prep mode
title: make a practice test from my notes before the exam

tools.name: Quizlet AI Study Tools (practice tests, AI study guides)

workflowSummary: Upload notes, slides, or readings and Quizlet's AI turns them into a graded practice test. Its Learn mode uses spaced repetition, repeating the questions you get wrong more often until you master them.
samplePrompt: Generate a 15-question practice test from these notes, mixing multiple choice and short answer, and explain the correct answer after I submit.
pricingNote: Some AI features free; advanced practice-test generation and homework help require Quizlet Plus - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public feature page, no login required to view

persona: Middle/high school and early-college students doing math homework
title: check my math homework and show me the steps
intentLabels: solve math problem step by step
workflowSummary: Point your phone camera at a printed or handwritten math problem (or type it in). Photomath solves it and shows every step, with an option to compare more than one solution method. The core step-by-step solver is free; animated video tutorials are a paid add-on.
samplePrompt: Scan the problem, then tap "show steps" and "alternate method" to compare two ways of solving it.
beginnerNote: camera-based, no typing needed, built for K-12/early college math
pricingNote: Free core solver; Photomath Plus roughly $9.99/mo or $69.99/yr for animated tutorials - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public app store listing, no login required to view

persona: Students writing essays and papers for class
title: fix the grammar and make my essay sound clearer
workflowSummary: Install the browser extension, desktop app, or paste text into the web editor. Grammarly underlines grammar, spelling, and clarity issues in real time and suggests full-sentence rewrites. The free plan covers the basics; Pro adds full rewrites and a plagiarism/AI-writing checker.
samplePrompt: Use the "Improve it" rewrite suggestion on each flagged sentence, then run the full-document clarity check before I submit.
beginnerNote: works passively as you type, minimal setup
pricingNote: Free plan (about 100 AI prompts/month); Pro roughly $12/mo billed annually ($30/mo billed monthly) - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public homepage; free account required to use the editor

persona: Students who miss details taking notes live in class
title: record my lecture and get a text summary afterward
workflowSummary: Open the Otter app or extension before class and hit record (or import an audio file afterward). Otter live-transcribes the lecture, identifies speakers, and generates an automatic summary and topic outline you can search later.
samplePrompt: Summarize this lecture into 5 key takeaways and list any dates or assignments the professor mentioned.
beginnerNote: easy to record, but the free plan's 30-minute-per-recording cap cuts off most full-length lectures
pricingNote: Free Basic plan (300 min/month, 30-min cap per recording); Pro $16.99/mo ($8.49/mo billed annually) - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; free account required to record

persona: Students writing research papers or essays that need cited evidence
title: find real research papers that support my essay's argument
workflowSummary: Type your research question in plain English, not keywords. Consensus searches 200M+ peer-reviewed papers and shows a "Consensus Meter" indicating whether the science leans yes, no, or mixed, with every claim linked back to its source paper.
samplePrompt: Does spaced repetition improve long-term memory retention compared to massed practice? Show me the top 5 most-cited studies.
beginnerNote: the natural-language search is easy, but interpreting the Consensus Meter and picking credible studies takes some guidance
pricingNote: Free tier (roughly 20 AI searches/month); Premium/Pro from about $9-15/month - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public site; free account needed to save searches

persona: Students formatting a bibliography or works-cited page
title: generate the citation for a website or book I used
workflowSummary: Paste in a URL, DOI, ISBN, or title, choose your citation style (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard), and Scribbr auto-fills and formats the reference entry and in-text citation, exportable straight into a Word document.
samplePrompt: Paste the article URL, select APA 7th edition, and export the finished reference list to Word.
beginnerNote: no account required for basic citations, plain form-based interface
pricingNote: 100% free for the citation generator itself; Scribbr's proofreading/plagiarism add-ons are paid - verify before publishing
freshness: Retrieved Sep 2026 (page dated Feb 2025, confirmed current)
accessNotes: Public tool, no login required

persona: Students worried their writing will get flagged by a school's AI checker
title: check if my essay might get flagged as AI-written before I submit it
workflowSummary: Paste your finished draft into the checker. It scans the text for patterns associated with AI-generated writing and gives a likelihood estimate, so you can revise sections that read as too uniform or generic before turning the assignment in.
samplePrompt: Paste in my final draft and flag any paragraph that reads as likely AI-written so I can revise it in my own words.
beginnerNote: simple paste-and-check flow
pricingNote: Free to use - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public tool suite page listing the AI Detector feature, no login required to view; NOTE - AI detectors (this one included) have known false-positive rates, especially for non-native English writers, so treat results as a signal, not a verdict

persona: STEM students (algebra through calculus, chemistry, stats, physics)
title: get step-by-step help solving a calculus or physics problem
workflowSummary: Type or photograph a math or science problem into Wolfram|Alpha. The free tool gives the answer; the Pro for Students plan unlocks the full step-by-step solution with hints, covering algebra through calculus, physics, chemistry, and statistics.
samplePrompt: integrate x^2 * sin(x) dx, show step by step
beginnerNote: the answer engine is simple, but full step-by-step help requires the paid Pro tier
pricingNote: Free basic answers; Pro for Students roughly $5-9.99/month or up to about $59.99/year - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public product page; free account for basic use, subscription required for Pro features

persona: Students taking a foreign-language class who want speaking practice
title: practice speaking the language I'm taking for class
workflowSummary: On top of the free Duolingo lessons, Max adds two AI features: Roleplay, where you act out a real scenario (ordering food, asking directions) with an AI character and get feedback on grammar and vocabulary, and Video Call, an open-ended spoken conversation with an AI character.
samplePrompt: Start a Roleplay scenario: ordering coffee in the language I'm learning, and give me feedback afterward on grammar and vocabulary variety.
beginnerNote: gamified interface most students already know
pricingNote: Core app free; Max roughly $29.99/month or about $168/year - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public blog post; free account for the base app; NOTE - Max's AI conversation features currently cover only 7 languages

persona: K-12 and early-college students who want a tutor, not just an answer
title: get a patient AI tutor to explain something I don't understand
workflowSummary: Chat with Khanmigo inside Khan Academy about any lesson. Instead of giving the answer outright, it asks guiding questions to walk you through your own reasoning, tied to Khan Academy's free lesson library.
samplePrompt: I don't understand why we multiply exponents when raising a power to a power - can you walk me through it without just giving me the answer?
beginnerNote: built specifically for students, low monthly cost
pricingNote: Khan Academy core content always free; Khanmigo for learners about $4/month or $44/year - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; free Khan Academy account required

persona: Students/recent grads applying for their first internship or job
title: build a resume for my first internship application
workflowSummary: Pick a template, enter your target job title or paste the job ad, and Kickresume's AI drafts resume bullet points and a matching cover letter, plus an ATS checker that flags formatting issues before you apply.
samplePrompt: Here's the internship job ad: [paste]. Write 3 resume bullet points for my retail job that highlight transferable skills for this role.
beginnerNote: guided, template-based flow
pricingNote: Free plan available; verified students get 6 months of Premium free via ISIC/ITIC/UNiDAYS; Premium otherwise roughly $7-19/month - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; student ID verification required to claim free Premium; NOTE - reviewers note AI-generated bullet points often need manual editing

persona: Students assigned a group or individual class presentation
title: turn my class notes into slides for a group presentation
workflowSummary: Type a short description of your presentation topic (or paste your notes), and Magic Design generates several complete slide-deck drafts with layouts, colors, and placeholder content, which you then edit and fill in with your own material.
samplePrompt: Create a presentation outline about the causes of the French Revolution for a 10-minute class presentation, with one slide per major cause.
beginnerNote: prompt-based generation, familiar drag-and-drop editor
pricingNote: Free plan (Magic Design usable up to 10 times free across versions); Pro roughly $12-15/month - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free account required to generate; NOTE - PowerPoint exports can shift layout

persona: Students who read better/faster by listening, including those with dyslexia or ADHD accommodations
title: listen to my textbook chapter instead of reading it
workflowSummary: Upload or scan a textbook page or PDF, or paste in an article, and Speechify reads it back in a natural-sounding voice at an adjustable speed, so you can listen while commuting, working out, or to reduce eye strain from screen reading.
samplePrompt: Import this PDF chapter and read it aloud at 1.5x speed with text highlighting turned on so I can follow along.
beginnerNote: simple import-and-play flow
pricingNote: Free plan available; Premium roughly $29/month or $139/year (student discounts sometimes offered) - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; free account required

persona: College students juggling classes, clubs, and a part-time job
title: make a study schedule that actually fits around my classes and deadlines
workflowSummary: Connect your class schedule, part-time job shifts, and assignment deadlines. Motion's AI automatically slots study blocks into your open time and reshuffles everything the moment something changes, like a canceled class or a late meeting.
samplePrompt: Add "Study for chemistry midterm" as a task due Friday at 9am, needing 6 hours total, and find the open blocks in my week to schedule it.
beginnerNote: the auto-scheduling concept takes a few days to trust, and there's no permanent free plan
pricingNote: No free plan; Pro AI $19/seat/mo billed annually ($29/mo billed monthly) - verify before publishing (a 25% student discount is cited by one third-party review but not confirmed on Motion's own pricing page)
accessNotes: Public pricing page; 7-day trial requires a payment card upfront

persona: High school and college students looking for money for school
title: find scholarships I actually qualify for
workflowSummary: Create a free profile describing your background, major, and interests. Bold.org's matching system surfaces scholarships - including quick "no-essay" ones - that fit your profile, and it manages the full application and payout process itself rather than linking out to other sites.
samplePrompt: Fill out my profile with my major, state, GPA, and background, then show me every no-essay scholarship I qualify for.
beginnerNote: guided profile setup, no essay required for some listings
pricingNote: Completely free for students - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public site; free profile required to get matches and apply; NOTE - only matches within Bold.org's own scholarship pool, not the wider scholarship universe, so pair with other sources

persona: Students who take handwritten notes on an iPad during lectures
title: turn my handwritten notes into typed, searchable text
workflowSummary: Write notes by hand in Notability during class (optionally recording the audio at the same time). Its AI-powered handwriting recognition converts your writing into searchable text and can convert handwritten math into typed equations, so you can find any note later by keyword.
samplePrompt: Convert this handwritten page to text, then search my whole notebook for the keyword "mitosis."
beginnerNote: built specifically for handwritten note-taking on iPad, iPhone, and Mac
pricingNote: Free Starter tier with usage limits; Plus about $19.99/year; Pro/AI-heavy tier about $99.99/year; some schools provide it free through Apple School Manager - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; free tier available; Apple devices only

persona: Students who need to email professors, TAs, or academic advisors
title: write a professional email to my professor
workflowSummary: In Gmail, click "Help me write" and type a one-line description of what you need. Gemini drafts a full, appropriately formal email you can shorten, elaborate, or "formalize" before sending.
samplePrompt: Ask my professor politely for a 2-day extension on my essay because I'm sick, and offer to send a doctor's note.
beginnerNote: one click inside an app most students already use daily
pricingNote: Free for all Gmail users as of the February 2026 rollout; some other Gmail AI features still require Google AI Pro/Ultra - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public blog post; feature appears directly inside Gmail; rollout is US-first and English-first

persona: College students managing a tight or irregular budget
title: help me budget my money as a college student
workflowSummary: Connect your bank account and chat with Cleo like a texting friend. It categorizes your spending, calculates what's left after bills, and can send a blunt "Roast Mode" reality check or an encouraging "Hype Mode" nudge, depending on which tone motivates you.
samplePrompt: How much did I spend on food delivery last month, and can I afford a $60 concert ticket this weekend?
beginnerNote: conversational chat interface, no spreadsheet setup
pricingNote: Core budgeting/chat free; Plus $5.99/mo, Pro $8.99/mo, Builder $14.99/mo for cash advances, savings, and credit-building - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public site; requires full read-only bank account access via Plaid and is only available to US residents 18+ - a real privacy trade-off worth flagging

persona: Students applying to many internships at once
title: autofill internship and job applications instead of typing everything by hand
workflowSummary: Build one profile with your resume and details, then install the Copilot browser extension. When you open an internship application on a company's site, Copilot auto-fills the form fields from your saved profile, cutting the retyping out of applying to each role.
samplePrompt: Open this internship application and autofill my name, school, resume, and work history from my saved profile.
beginnerNote: install once, works automatically on supported sites
pricingNote: Free forever for autofill, matching, and the tracker; paid Simplify+ adds AI resume/cover-letter tailoring - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public site; free account and browser extension required; NOTE - autofill accuracy is more variable on complex systems like Workday per independent reviewers

persona: Students juggling assignments across several classes
title: keep track of all my assignments and due dates in one place
workflowSummary: Type an assignment in plain language and Todoist's natural-language parser sets the date and time automatically. The AI Task Assist feature (on paid plans) can break a big assignment into smaller subtasks and suggest a schedule.
samplePrompt: Read chapters 4-6 for Bio, due Thursday 9am, high priority - break this into subtasks I can finish each night this week.
beginnerNote: natural-language task entry, familiar to-do-list format
pricingNote: Free Beginner plan (5 projects, basic reminders); Pro about $5/mo billed annually ($7/mo billed monthly) for AI Task Assist and more projects - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public help center page; free account to use the app; NOTE - Todoist's education discount program was retired in 2021 and hasn't returned

persona: Students who miss a lecture or want to review a recorded class video
title: turn a recorded lecture or class video into notes I can study from
workflowSummary: Paste a YouTube link or upload a recorded lecture file, and Notta transcribes it, generates an AI summary of the key points, and lets you "chat" with the transcript afterward to ask questions about the content.
samplePrompt: Summarize this recorded lecture into 5 main topics and list anything the professor said would be on the exam.
beginnerNote: upload or paste a link and go, no technical setup
pricingNote: Free plan (120 transcription minutes/month); Pro from about $8.17/mo billed annually; student/educator discount available with a school email - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; free account required; student discount requires an edu email

persona: Students taking multiple classes who want one place for everything
title: keep my notes and documents organized across all my classes in one place
workflowSummary: Set up one workspace with a page per class, and use Notion's databases to track notes, readings, and assignments side by side. The free/Plus plans give unlimited notes and organization; the full AI layer (asking questions across all your notes, auto-summaries) requires the pricier Business plan.
samplePrompt: Summarize everything across my Biology and Chemistry pages that's related to cellular respiration.
beginnerNote: very flexible, but that flexibility means some setup time before it feels organized
pricingNote: Free for individuals (unlimited pages, limited AI trial); full Notion AI requires Business at about $20/member/month - verify before publishing
freshness: Retrieved Sep 2026 (checked Jul 31, 2026 per third-party sources)
accessNotes: Public page; free account for core organization features; NOTE - full AI search/summarization moved behind the paid Business plan in 2025

persona: Students assigned a group project with classmates
title: split up tasks and see who's doing what for a group project
workflowSummary: Build a shared project page with a kanban board or table listing each task, who it's assigned to, and its due date. Every group member edits the same live page, so nobody needs a separate spreadsheet or group chat to know what's left to do.
samplePrompt: Create a board with columns To Do / In Progress / Done, and add one card per task with an assignee and due date for our group presentation.
beginnerNote: easy once set up, but building the first board takes some tinkering
pricingNote: Free for individuals and small collaborative groups; team-wide admin features require paid plans - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; free account required, and each group member needs their own free Notion account to edit

persona: Students trying to find an internship through alumni or professional connections
title: find alumni or professionals I could reach out to for an internship
workflowSummary: Simplify's Network Copilot searches your existing connections and its broader network against a job posting you're interested in and surfaces people - like alumni from your school - who might be willing to refer you or answer questions about the role.
samplePrompt: Show me people connected to this company who went to my school or studied my major.
beginnerNote: useful once you have a specific job posting in mind, less useful for open-ended browsing
pricingNote: Included free with a Simplify account - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public site; free account required; NOTE - newer, less-reviewed feature compared to Simplify's well-established autofill tool

persona: Students preparing for an internship or job interview
title: practice for a job or internship interview out loud
workflowSummary: Do a spoken mock interview with an AI interviewer that asks real follow-up questions based on your answers. Afterward, Yoodli gives you a report on filler words, pacing, and clarity, so you can see concretely what to fix before the real interview.
samplePrompt: Start a behavioral interview roleplay for a marketing internship, and give me a report on filler words and pacing when I'm done.
beginnerNote: just talk to it, no setup beyond picking a scenario
pricingNote: Free (5 lifetime practice sessions total); Pro about $8/mo billed annually (10 sessions/week); Advanced about $20/mo (unlimited) - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free account to start; some schools provide free access via a student tech fee; NOTE - coaches delivery, not content quality

persona: Students in a language class or reading assignments in a non-native language
title: translate a reading assignment that's not in English
workflowSummary: Paste text or upload a document (PDF, Word) into DeepL, and it translates it using neural machine translation that's widely reported to outperform Google Translate on European language pairs, preserving formatting on document uploads.
samplePrompt: Translate this assigned reading from French to English, keeping the paragraph breaks intact.
beginnerNote: paste-and-translate interface, no account needed for basic text
pricingNote: Free (50,000 characters/month, 1 document translation/month); Individual plan about $8.74/mo billed annually for unlimited text and more documents - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public help center page; no account required for basic text translation

persona: Students who get nervous giving in-class presentations
title: practice giving my class presentation out loud before I present it for real
workflowSummary: Rehearse your presentation out loud in front of Yoodli instead of a mirror. It transcribes what you say in real time and scores your pacing, filler-word use, and eye contact (via webcam), so you can run it again and watch the numbers improve before the real thing.
samplePrompt: Start a presentation practice session, time it to 5 minutes, and flag every time I say "um" or "like."
beginnerNote: same simple record-and-review flow as the interview mode
pricingNote: Free (5 lifetime sessions, shared across all Yoodli use cases); Pro about $8/mo billed annually - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free account to start; NOTE - same 5-lifetime-session cap as the interview-prep row, shared across uses

persona: Students who don't know where to start looking for an internship
title: find internships or part-time jobs that match my major and interests
workflowSummary: Build your profile once with your major, skills, and interests, and Simplify's AI matches it against a database of live job and internship postings, showing you roles ranked by fit rather than making you scroll a generic job board.
samplePrompt: Filter my matched internships to marketing roles for summer 2027 that are open to sophomores.
beginnerNote: profile-based matching, minimal manual searching
pricingNote: Free for job seekers, matches included - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free account required to save matches

persona: Students who want to showcase projects, design work, or a portfolio online
title: build a simple portfolio website to show off my projects
intentLabels: generate a website from a prompt
workflowSummary: Describe your portfolio in a short prompt, and Framer's AI generates a complete, responsive site with sections and draft copy that you then refine visually on its canvas before publishing.
samplePrompt: Create a portfolio website for a design student, with sections for About, 4 projects, and a contact form.
beginnerNote: free to start, no code required, AI does the first draft
pricingNote: Free plan available; Mini $5/site/month, Basic $15/site/month for a custom domain and more pages - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free account to start building; NOTE - reviewers note the AI output is a starting point that needs manual refinement, not a finished product

persona: Students building a LinkedIn profile for internship or job searching
title: write a stronger LinkedIn headline and About section
workflowSummary: From the Headline or About section of your own profile, LinkedIn's built-in AI writing assistant reads your existing profile and generates personalized suggestions you can accept, edit, or skip.
samplePrompt: Open the Headline field on my profile and use the AI writing assistant to see suggested rewrites.
beginnerNote: one button inside LinkedIn's own editing flow
pricingNote: Requires an active LinkedIn Premium subscription (paid) - verify current price and plan requirement before publishing
accessNotes: Public help page; feature requires a paid LinkedIn Premium account to access; NOTE - reviewers say suggestions can feel generic and still benefit from a personal rewrite

persona: Students promoting a club event, fundraiser, or meeting
title: design a flyer for my club's event
workflowSummary: Type a description of the event, and Adobe Express generates several fully editable flyer templates you can customize with your own text, photos, and club colors.
samplePrompt: Generate a poster for a campus club bake sale fundraiser happening Saturday at noon in the quad.
beginnerNote: prompt-to-template flow, no design experience required
pricingNote: Free plan with limited generative AI credits; Premium about $9.99/month for more credits and features - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free Adobe account required to generate and download

persona: Students networking at career fairs or club recruitment events
title: design business cards for networking events
workflowSummary: Use Adobe Express's template generator to describe the business card you want, and it produces editable card designs you can customize with your own branding before printing or sharing digitally.
samplePrompt: Generate a simple, modern business card template for a marketing student with my name, phone number, and LinkedIn QR code.
beginnerNote: same prompt-to-template flow as the flyer feature
pricingNote: Free plan with limited generative AI credits; Premium about $9.99/month - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free Adobe account required

persona: Students who run a club's or org's Instagram/TikTok
title: turn a video clip into a short promotional reel for my club's social media
workflowSummary: Upload raw video clips into CapCut, and its AI tools auto-generate captions, suggest cuts and transitions, and can extend or remove backgrounds - the free version covers the full basic editing toolkit needed for a polished short-form reel.
samplePrompt: Auto-generate captions for this clip, trim it to 30 seconds, and add a trending transition between the two scenes.
beginnerNote: one of the most widely used short-form editing apps among students already
pricingNote: Free to download and edit; Standard about $9.99/month (removes watermarks); Pro about $19.99/month for 4K export and the full AI toolkit - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free download, no account required for basic editing; NOTE - some templates/effects are marked Pro and add a watermark unless subscribed

persona: Students applying for a scholarship, internship, or program that accepts video submissions
title: make a short intro video about myself for a scholarship or internship application
workflowSummary: Record yourself talking to your phone camera, then use CapCut's AI auto-captions, background noise reduction, and simple cut tools to trim it into a clean, polished 60-90 second intro without professional editing skills.
samplePrompt: Add auto-captions to this recording, trim out the pauses, and clean up the background audio.
beginnerNote: same simple mobile-editing flow as the reel row
pricingNote: Free to download and edit; paid tiers remove watermarks and unlock 4K/full AI toolkit - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free download, no account required for basic editing

persona: Students starting a club, small side hustle, or personal brand that needs a logo
title: create a logo for my club or small side hustle
workflowSummary: Enter your organization's name and pick style preferences, and Looka's AI generates dozens of logo concepts to choose from and customize. Designing is free; you pay only when you're ready to download the final files.
samplePrompt: Generate logo concepts for "Campus Coffee Collective," a student-run coffee cart, using warm colors and a modern sans-serif font.
beginnerNote: guided style-picker flow, no design skill needed
pricingNote: Free to design; Basic Logo Package $20 one-time (PNG only); Premium Logo Package $65 one-time (vector files, full ownership) - verify before publishing
sourceType: Directory / review page (no official looka.com pricing URL surfaced directly in search)
accessNotes: Public review page; official product at looka.com; free account to design, payment required to download - NOTE - there is no free download option at all

persona: Students trying to build a LinkedIn presence before graduating
title: know what to post on LinkedIn to grow my personal brand
workflowSummary: Taplio's AI drafts LinkedIn posts from a topic or draws on a searchable library of millions of high-performing posts for inspiration, then schedules them, so you can post consistently without staring at a blank page each week.
samplePrompt: Generate a LinkedIn post about what I learned from my summer internship, in a reflective, first-person tone.
beginnerNote: the writing tools are simple, but there's real cost and risk to weigh before committing
pricingNote: No free plan; Starter about $39/mo (ships with zero AI credits); Growth about $65-69/mo (250 AI credits/month) - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; 7-day free trial with full access; requires a LinkedIn account and browser extension; NOTE - connects via a browser extension rather than LinkedIn's official API, which is the kind of automation LinkedIn has enforced against before (a real account-safety consideration)

persona: Students building a personal brand or small content-creation side project on Instagram/TikTok
title: build a link-in-bio page for my Instagram or TikTok
workflowSummary: Beacons builds a single mobile-friendly page with all your links, social profiles, and any products you sell, and its AI teammate "Beam" can design the page layout for you from a text prompt with one click.
samplePrompt: Design my link-in-bio page with a clean, minimal look in blue and white, and add sections for my portfolio, Instagram, and email list.
beginnerNote: guided setup, genuinely free to start
pricingNote: Free forever plan; Creator $10/mo, Creator Plus $30/mo, Creator Max $90/mo for more email sends and 0% seller fees - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public pricing page; free account required; NOTE - selling anything through the free/Creator plans carries a 9% transaction fee

persona: Students running a club or organization that sends regular updates to members
title: write and send a newsletter for my student organization
workflowSummary: Describe your newsletter's topic and tone to Mailchimp's AI content generator, and it drafts the subject line and body copy for you, which you then drop into a template and send to your member list.
samplePrompt: Draft a newsletter announcing our club's spring fundraiser, in a friendly and upbeat tone, with a call to action to RSVP.
beginnerNote: the free plan works for a small member list, but the AI writing tools specifically require a paid upgrade
pricingNote: Free plan (500 contacts, 1,000 sends/month, no automation); Essentials $13/mo (adds automation, no AI); Standard $20/mo (unlocks AI content generation) - verify before publishing
accessNotes: Public page; free account for the base plan; AI content features require the paid Standard plan

persona: Students promoting a club event or personal project on social media
title: write catchy social media captions to promote an event
workflowSummary: Describe the event and the platform you're posting to, and Copy.ai generates several caption options in different tones, plus relevant hashtag ideas, that you can mix, edit, and post directly or schedule.
samplePrompt: Write 3 Instagram captions promoting our club's charity 5K this Saturday - one playful, one motivational, one straightforward with event details.
beginnerNote: simple prompt-and-generate flow
pricingNote: Free plan (2,000 words/month, 1 seat); Pro about $49/month for unlimited words and more seats - verify before publishing
sourceType: Directory / review page (no single official copy.ai pricing URL surfaced directly in search)
accessNotes: Public review page; official product at copy.ai; free account to start

persona: Students preparing to introduce themselves at a career fair or networking event
title: write a short elevator pitch about myself for networking events
